description: Every company with securities registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission — its Central Index Key (CIK), ticker symbol, exchange and legal name, from the SEC's EDGAR system.
name: edgar

fields.description: SEC EDGAR Central Index Key — the registrant's identifier in EDGAR, stored as an integer. Unpadded: no leading zeros are stored and none are implied, so the decimal rendering of this column is the CIK. The SEC renders a CIK zero-padded in URLs and filenames (`CIK0000320193`); that is a rendering convention applied to the identifier, not the value the company-tickers file this column is built from carries, and the Parquet column is a signed 64-bit integer. Join it to `edgar_gleif.key` by rendering it as text — see that package's `x-joins`.
fields.name: cik

fields.description: Legal name of the registrant as carried in the SEC company-tickers file. The type on this field is declared by Meridian, not inferred: finetype returns `representation.text.entity_name` on 572 of 600 independent 100-value samples of this column and one of four other types on the rest, so an inferred label here is a draw. `x-finetype-confidence` on this field is that agreement rate over 600 samples of this exact object, NOT a model score for a single run.
fields.name: company_name

fields.description: Exchange ticker symbol for the registrant's security.
fields.name: ticker

fields.description: Listing venue for the ticker (e.g. NYSE, Nasdaq, CBOE, OTC).
fields.name: exchange

fields.description: Lowercased, accent-stripped concatenation of name + ticker + exchange — a derived free-text search field, not a source attribute. The type on this field is declared by Meridian, not inferred: finetype returns `representation.text.plain_text` on 484 of 600 independent 100-value samples of this column, `unknown` on 97 and one of seven other types on the rest, so an inferred label here is a draw. `x-finetype-confidence` on this field is that agreement rate over 600 samples of this exact object, NOT a model score for a single run.
fields.name: corpus

title: SEC EDGAR — Company Tickers
